items.title: Reddit stock jumps on inclusion in S&P 500
items.summary: Reddit shares jumped on the company's inclusion in the S&P 500.

items.title: Mamdani's NYC pied-à-terre tax can continue rollout during court appeal
items.summary: The tax championed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani has drawn the ire of President Donald Trump, who said it must be stopped and vowed to explore federal options.

items.title: Kennedy Center board votes to put Trump name on facade despite court order
items.summary: President Donald Trump's name was removed from the Washington, D.C., performing arts center in June as the result of a lawsuit by an Ohio congresswoman.

items.title: Tôm hùm Canada giá rẻ hút khách
items.summary: Tôm hùm Canada hiện khá hút khách khi giá chỉ bằng một phần ba hàng Australia và thấp hơn cả một số loại tôm trong nước.

items.title: Flock says its new tool will help identify police abuse, but hasn’t explained how it works
items.summary: The surveillance company announced it's making a tool called "Audit Assistance" mandatory for all customers, claiming it's already helped catch abuse. But the company has yet to explain how the tool works in detail, raising questions about its effectiveness.

items.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
items.summary: Apple now sends out push notifications to iPhone lock screens when the company identifies government spyware targeting someone's devices.

items.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
items.summary: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.

items.title: Microsoft’s Clippy-like Mico character is no longer the face of Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft Copilot will no longer show its emotive yellow blob, Mico, when you use the chatbot's voice mode. In a support page, Microsoft says it's going to move Mico to its Learn Live platform, where the avatar will have "more to react to," as reported earlier by GeekWire.
